description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source test management software. It provides functionality for exporting test cases in XML format, particularly for bulk execution. The script handles initialization, collects parameters from HTTP requests, constructs XML representations of test plans, contexts, and test cases, and triggers file downloads.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves request parameters related to exporting, such as export type, filename, project and plan IDs, and other context information.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI-related configurations and context data for export operation based on provided arguments and test plan.

methods.name: contentAsXML
methods.description: Generates an XML string representing the entire execution set, including context and test case set.

methods.name: contextAsXML
methods.description: Builds the XML representation of the context, including test project, plan, build, and platform details.

methods.name: tcaseSetAsXML
methods.description: Creates XML for a set of test cases based on the context's test case versions.
